text:
alex: quick RFC follow-up: we need final decisions on soft vs hard demote semantics and what telemetry to add before canary.

sam: i prefer soft first, hard only after central confirm. avoids flashing 429s to customers. :+1:

priya: soft demote = reduced qps and slight backoff suggestion header. hard = 429. soft must include X-Redwood-Soft-Demotion header so SDKs can opt-in to smooth behavior.

miguel: telemetry must include labels: tenant_id, route, decision (allow|soft_demote|hard_reject), reason_tag, local_or_central, window_ms. without these filtering on the dashboard is painful.

jess: question: where does abuse scoring live? central coordinator or local ingress heuristic? central = consistent, local = fast.

priya: hybrid: local heuristics for immediate reaction (100ms-5s) but only soft demote. central reconciler every 30s can escalate to hard_reject. this balances speed and correctness.

alex: ok that seems practical. need to ensure we can measure false-positive rate. what sampling do we want?

miguel: sample one in 100 demoted requests with full abuse signal snapshot and trace id. never log payloads, just reference trace.

jess: add abuse_signals label for sampled events (e.g. rapid_repeats, high_token_cost, anon_proxy). also tag whether metadata extraction succeeded (for multiplexed connections).

infra-bot: canary will be rolled to 10% of ingress pods. new telemetry labels appear under telemetry.v2 in ~2 hours post-deploy.

sam: config sketch for local tests: 
```
local_heuristic:
  window_ms: 2000
  burst_threshold: 3
  action: soft_demote
central_reconcile:
  interval_s: 30
  escalate_after_hits: 5
  action: hard_reject
headers:
  soft_demote: X-Redwood-Soft-Demotion
```

priya: rollout plan: 10% pods -> 10 tenants -> 50 tenants, measure 95p latency and demote rate for 48h between steps.

miguel: note: expect ~200 extra metric series due to labels; quota telemetry shard may need bump. pinging infra-sre.

jess: scheduler interaction: when soft_demote apply, reduce batch weight (e.g. *0.5) and add admission retry delay +50ms. hard_reject bypasses scheduler.

sam: i'll prototype weight multiplier in scheduler repo.

alex: action items: miguel - add metadata extraction to prefilter + telemetry (due EOD tomorrow); priya - canary runbook + success criteria (due Fri COB); sam - scheduler weight prototype (due next Wed); jess - finalize abuse signal list + sampling policy (due Fri); infra-bot - schedule canary when ready.

miguel: ack, will add extraction hook and update telemetry schema.

jess: SDK question: should SDKs surface soft demote header to logs? recommendation: SDK logs at debug and provide opt-in hook.

priya: opt-in only. customers may misinterpret header as error otherwise.

alex: agreed. i'll update RFC with demotion examples and FAQ. next sync in 48h unless issues.

sam: :thumbsup:

miguel: :eyes:

jess: thanks all, i'll share sampling draft.
